purpose: Teach: 森下/片岡/水谷/丹羽/高岡/今村/津田/岡村

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の森下先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren, inherit the research direction that Professor Morishita, your dissertation advisor, has been developing.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. No inflection upward—this is fact, not question. Weight on the name and the task. Composed authority that expects compliance without drama.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。片岡教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Kataoka's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Quiet, focused agreement. Slight nod-like quality in the delivery. Efficient—no wasted words. The tone of someone already mentally organizing his next step.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の水谷先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren, reach out to Professor Mizutani for consultation on the collaborative research.
lines.style: Another directive, steady rhythm. The name carries slight emphasis. Professional courtesy—not harsh, but business-like. Expects action.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で丹羽助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll attend the academic conference to hear Assistant Professor Niwa's presentation.
lines.style: Immediate acceptance. Quick cadence. Slightly higher pitch than before—this task engages him more. Still formal but with subtle energy underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の高岡先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren, make sure you also reference Professor Takaoka's papers in your literature review.
lines.style: Continued directives, same measured tempo. The accumulation of tasks matter-of-fact. No apology or softening—this is how mentorship works. Brief, authoritative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の今村先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll seek guidance from my senior colleague Imamura in the lab.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Slight breath before the response—he's listening carefully. Respectful register toward the senior. Clipped but not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の津田教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren, arrange a meeting with Professor Tsuda from our overseas partnership program.
lines.style: Final directive in the sequence. Slight weight on the name. The pace steady, unchanged—this is routine for Hiroshi. Authority without heat.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、岡村事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the application through Okamura in the administrative office for research funding.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Quieter than the first response, as if he's already moving on to the next task. Professional, efficient—the tone of someone who will do exactly what was asked.
